description:
A majestic dark presence; its deepest nature remains partly unexplained.

Boats, crossings and livelihoods depend on a presence that cannot be reduced to a final enemy. Sailors know a run of current or a dangerous landing; that knowledge does not grant knowledge of her nature.

Proposed recurring presentation: early, the great lamp passes over familiar moorings with the expected sound of water against timber. Much later, a crossing can repeat the same movement while a wave reaches the hull before its sound. Give the player a familiar rhythm to recognize before withholding one part of it. The anomaly remains an experience, not a collectible explanation of the sea.

§§3.1, 5.1 and 30: majestic sea, proposed sensory disturbances and ordinary crews. Recurring beam-and-hull staging is proposed.
